entries.subject: BlendingMode.Normal on the user channels (RGB16, sRGB8, RGB8, RGB16F, L16, RGB32F)
entries.formula: Per channel, float32 arithmetic (fma: fused multiply-add, one rounding). Operands a (lower layer) and b (upper source) as stored: RGB16/L16 c/65535; RGB8 c/255; sRGB8 the linear value IEC-decode(c/255) on 8 significant bits (blend in linear); RGB16F the stored half; RGB32F float32(c/65535). On UNORM formats (RGB16, L16, RGB8, sRGB8) r is clamped to [0, 1] before the opacity mix; float formats keep r unclamped unless the mode clamps. Opacity alpha = float32(opacity): v = a*(1 - alpha) + r*alpha. Write: UNORM n bits: v clamped to [0, 1], j = floor(v*2^(n+4)), code = (j*(2^n - 1) + 2^(n+3) - 1) >> (n+4) (nearest, ties down, after truncation to n+4 fractional bits); sRGB8 code = round(255*encode_IEC(v)); RGB16F half rounded toward zero; RGB32F 1 + (v - 1) in float32 (composite over the white base: |v| < 0.5 lands on 2^-24 steps, v < 0 on 2^-23 steps). entries.subject: Order of evaluation of the layer stack (three non-commuting layers, four orders)
entries.formula: The stack is evaluated bottom-up starting from the white base (1.0 on user channels): value = 1; for each layer from the bottom: value = stored(blend(mode, value, source, opacity)) with the separable kernels, opacity mix and storage write of the entries blend-normal, blend-subtract and blend-divide; every layer result is written to the channel format before the next layer reads it. Layers: A fields A, Normal, 1.0; B fields B, Subtract, 0.8; C uniform colour (0.6, 0.3, 0.9) stored like a channel value (RGB16 UNORM write, sRGB8 round(255*encode_IEC)), Divide, 0.6. Orders ABC, BAC, ACB, CBA in s0..s3.

entries.subject: BlendingMode.PassThrough (group layers only)
entries.formula: A group in PassThrough does not composite its children into an isolated result: the children blend directly onto the stack below the group, as if they were not grouped (the usual pass-through group definition).
entries.notes: Not settable through the documented API on Painter 12.1.0 (group-only mode); the group cases moved to task phase0.7_tier0-semantics-ui-cases. No residual.

entries.subject: BlendingMode Tint on the user channels
entries.formula: Tint: f = HSV(hue of B, saturation and value of A) with the value multiplied by 2; RGB -> HSV: v = max, s = (max - min) / (max + eps), hue by the hexcone sector (0 for a grey); HSV -> RGB: v * (1 - s + s * clamp(|6 fract(h + k) - 3| - 1, 0, 1)), k = (1, 2/3, 1/3). Computed in float64 on linear operands; f is clamped to [0, 1] on integer formats (sRGB8 included) and not clamped on float formats; result A * (1 - opacity) + f * opacity. On a grey (L) channel Tint, Saturation and Color keep A and Value takes B, without gain. Operands are fields A (lower) and B (upper) as the channel stores them (blend-inputs): integer codes / (2^bits - 1), linear values on sRGB8 (the channel's 16-bit export / 65535), the stored half on RGB16F, float32(code / 65535) of the authored fixtures on RGB32F. Writes: RGB16/L16 and RGB8 take v clamped to [0, 1], truncated to bits + 4 fractional binary digits and rounded to the nearest code, ties down; sRGB8 writes round(255 * encode(v)) with the IEC 61966-2-1 encoding; RGB16F rounds to half toward zero; RGB32F stores 1 + (v - 1) in float32 (composite over the white base).

public_sources.locator: Blending modes: Tint, Saturation, Color, Value

entries.notes: The gain of 2 on the value is exact (the value of every unclipped texel matches 2 * max to the code on RGB16) and holds on every RGB channel and opacity; it is absent on the L16 channel. The W3C luminosity variant (Lum weights 0.3, 0.59, 0.11, ClipColor) and an HSL variant do not match (grey A gives 2A, not Lum or L). The saturation epsilon 2^-12 was fitted (median of the implied epsilon 2.44e-4). The residual is a hue offset: on RGB16 the measured hue fraction is (mid - min - n) / (max - min + m) with m = 2^-12 and n = 2^-11 or -2^-10 depending on which channel is the middle one; it is not reproduced (open item) and grows without bound where the hue source is nearly grey (max - min of a few codes).

entries.subject: BlendingMode NormalMapCombine on the user channels and the Normal channel
entries.formula: NormalMapCombine: a, b = normalise(2c - 1) of the lower (A) and upper (B) colours with z clamped to >= 0 before normalising; b is first rotated toward the flat normal (0,0,1) by the layer opacity (spherical interpolation, b' = slerp((0,0,1), b, opacity)); whiteout: r = normalise(a.xy + b.xy, a.z * b.z); the result is written as r * 0.5 + 0.5 (opacity enters only through b'). float32 arithmetic: dot products rounded once to float32, normalise(v) = v * float32(1 / sqrt(dot(v, v))). On a grey (L) channel the result is B. On the Normal channel the stored A and B are the imported bitmaps (r, 1 - g, b) rounded to half toward zero; the Normal_OpenGL virtual map writes normalise(2n - 1) * 0.5 + 0.5 of the stored channel n to 16 bits. Operands are fields A (lower) and B (upper) as the channel stores them (blend-inputs): integer codes / (2^bits - 1), linear values on sRGB8 (the channel's 16-bit export / 65535), the stored half on RGB16F, float32(code / 65535) of the authored fixtures on RGB32F. Data conversion rules: FLOAT to UNORM, FLOAT to FLOAT16

entries.notes: Exact on the Normal channel (half) and on RGB8, L16 against both recordings. RGB16 differs by one code on at most 0.2 % of the values, RGB16F by one half step, RGB32F by float rounding (the evaluation order of the float32 operations is not pinned down). sRGB8 differs by one code on about 4 % of the values, like the uniform-colour store (srgb-transfer); its operands are the channel's exported linear values (the IEC decode instead leaves up to 30 codes near zero-length vectors, where normalising amplifies small operand differences). Opacity 0.25 on RGB32F: spherical interpolation matches within 2e-7 (4e-6 with the blend-inputs export as operands), a normalised linear interpolation toward (0,0,1) leaves 0.03 and a linear interpolation of the encoded colours 0.38. Candidates rejected on the Normal channel (max |delta|, half): UDN 0.05, partial derivatives 0.04, linear 0.16 for Combine; whiteout 0.07 and swapped RNM 0.06 for Detail.

entries.subject: A normal bitmap on the Normal channel in Normal mode, and the Normal_OpenGL virtual map
entries.formula: The Normal channel (RGB16F) stores an imported 16-bit normal bitmap as (r, 1 - g, b) of code / 65535 (green inverted), rounded to half toward zero. The Normal_OpenGL virtual map writes normalise(2n - 1) * 0.5 + 0.5 of the stored channel n in float32 to 16 bits: truncated to 20 fractional binary digits, rounded to the nearest code, ties down.
